text: Free demo: run your own ice cream shop, somewhere in the Caribbean.
Pull the soft serve, scoop the flavours, dip the cones in toppings.
Then restock, clean up, hire staff, and grow a little stand into a busy shop.
Best part: the ice cream physics. It flows, swirls, and you can build a ridiculous tower.
The catch? The customers look stiff next to how good the food looks.
The demo is about two point seven gigs, in seventeen languages.
Think Supermarket Simulator, but everything melts.
Worth a dip. Bring a spoon.
